name: Wildmane Water Well
summary: At Wildmane Water Well, poisoned waters threaten Mulgore’s northern plains and the herds that depend on them.

sections.title: A Lifeblood Under Siege
sections.body: Across Mulgore, sacred wells sustain the nomadic tauren and their wandering kodo herds. Wildmane Water Well lies at the northern edge of the plains, just beyond Thunder Bluff’s shadow. The Venture Company’s goblins have poisoned its waters to control the regional supply. A tauren-crafted totem is needed for the cleansing ritual that can make the water pure again.

faq.q: Where is the Wildmane Water Well located?
faq.answer: Wildmane Water Well lies on Mulgore’s plains, directly north of Thunder Bluff’s mesas. It is the northernmost of the sacred wells that sustain the region.

faq.q: Why is the well important to the tauren?
aliases: why do tauren care about the well
faq.answer: Fresh water sustains life on the plains. The tauren hold the wells sacred because they supply settlements, traveling hunters, and the kodo herds roaming Mulgore.

faq.q: Who has tried to sabotage or control the well?
faq.answer: The Venture Company’s goblins have poisoned Wildmane Water Well to control Mulgore’s water supply. The tauren can cleanse it with a sacred totem.

angles.text: As a tauren, you know Mulgore’s sacred wells are gifts from the Earth Mother. Defending Wildmane Water Well from defilement and poison is a sacred duty for every young brave.
As a druid, you know the goblins’ attempts to corrupt Mulgore’s fresh water threaten the plains’ balance. You must remain vigilant and cleanse and heal the land.
